full_training.checkpoint_selection: Primary comparison uses common final epoch; earliest lowest patient-macro EMA noise-loss checkpoint is secondary.
full_training.stopping: Stop both variants at the same epoch only when both meet the frozen plateau rule, or at the maximum epoch. A resource stop is incomplete.

evaluation.outside_range_policy: Retain and report separately as flagged offline research; excluded from operating-point selection.
evaluation.selection_rule: Require direction coverage, patient-macro SSIM and mean-judge other-axis stability constraints; maximise mean-judge paired target-minus-null hit difference, then lower timestep, then lower guidance. Nonpositive or infeasible candidates produce no selected setting.
evaluation.anatomy_validation: unknown; SSIM constraints are provisional correspondence screens, not anatomical approval
evaluation.judge_input_frame: Invert each source header-derived canonical transform before grading; assessors remain frozen development instruments.
evaluation.reporting: Each named judge, both axes/directions, support strata, patient intervals, all failures; confirmation seeds are stability checks on the same validation patients, not a fresh test.

resources.cost_status: Execution caps only; cloud price and monetary cap must be agreed before a substantial paid run.

interpretation.limits: Unpaired acquisition-conditioned development on existing train/validation patients. Protocol confounding remains; selection is provisional and does not validate physical interventions or pathology preservation.
